run_autoregressive_generation: run the autoregressive text generation CLI with a HuggingFace Llama model and prompt input
run_self_speculative_generation: run the self-speculative text generation CLI with a HuggingFace Llama model and prompt input
load_model_and_tokenizer: load a HuggingFace causal LM model and tokenizer from a local model path
setup_distributed_process_group: setup the PyTorch distributed process group with gloo or nccl backend for inference
process_cli_arguments: process CLI arguments into Arguments, GenerateArguments, and GenerationConfig dataclasses using HfArgumentParser
